# Eagle Byte

> Eagle Byte is a premium digital engineering studio founded by Kartik Parmar,
> based in Gujarat, India, serving clients worldwide. It engineers
> high-performance websites, enterprise web applications, mobile apps,
> AI agents, workflow automation, and cloud infrastructure.

Founder: Kartik Parmar (Founder & Lead Developer)
Location: Gujarat, India
Contact: contact@eaglebyte.in | +91 97734 05142
Website: https://eaglebyte.in

## Services

- Custom Website Development: marketing sites, e-commerce, headless CMS, landing pages
- Enterprise Web Applications: role-based access, audit trails, integrations
- Mobile Applications: iOS, Android, React Native, offline-first sync
- AI & Machine Learning: autonomous AI agents, LLM integration, chatbots, predictive analytics
- Workflow Automation: business process automation and digitization
- SaaS Development: MVP to scale, multi-tenant platforms
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS/GCP, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, cost optimization
- Product Design: UI/UX design systems, prototyping, brand identity
- Technical Consulting: architecture, security, performance and SEO audits, fractional CTO
